title: kaizen auto-handoff config
description: Declarative config for the context-pressure auto-handoff trigger. Loaded by skills/workflow/scripts/auto_handoff.py.

valid_thresholds.description: Allowed user-picked threshold %s (single source for session_mode.py --threshold validation).

dedupe_event_type.description: dxm event type written on first fire; subsequent calls dedupe via this marker.

decision.description: block = Stop hook prevents exit until handoff lands. systemMessage = advisory only. Fallback when no rubric.yaml present.

reason_template.description: Template text emitted to the agent. Vars: {pct} {threshold} {tokens}.

on_bucket.description: Per-bucket action policy when rubric.yaml drives classification. Keys are bucket names declared in rubric.yaml. Values may be null (no-op) or an action object.
